cards.title: Everything that happened, in order
cards.text: 57 on-track passes, 26 pit stops, 2 cars that never finished, 1 safety car.

cards.title: 24 places changed hands on track before the first lap was done
cards.text: 22 cars into the first corner on cold tyres and full tanks.
bullets: 5 drivers gained 2 places each, the most of anybody
cards.note: Most of this is the pack sorting itself out. Some of it decides the race.

cards.text: 53 laps to make up ground from there.

cards.title: Russell takes the lead from Piastri
cards.text: A pass for the lead, made on track at racing speed.

cards.title: Track at 37°C at the start, falling to 30°C at the flag
cards.text: Track temperature changes how much grip the tyres find and how fast they wear. No rain was recorded during the race.

cards.title: Hulkenberg: 8 passes
cards.text: More than anybody else out there, in an Audi.
bullets: P13 on the grid, P11 at the flag
cards.note: Only moves made on track count, with the car ahead at racing speed.

cards.kicker: Your call on the pit wall
cards.title: You are Russell, 1.8s behind Piastri and going nowhere. Now what?
cards.text: Stuck behind another car your tyres overheat and the car will not turn. Stopping first gives you clean track for two or three laps, which is the whole trick behind the undercut.

choices.label: Box now and undercut
choices.sub: Fresh tyres, clean air, two laps to make it pay

choices.label: Stay out and overcut
choices.sub: Let him stop first, then push on an empty track

choices.label: Forget strategy, pass him
choices.sub: Send it and take the risk

outcomes.box: You spend about 24s in the lane and come out in traffic, betting that two fast laps on new tyres are worth more than the place you just gave up.
outcomes.wait: You stay on old rubber while he gets new ones, and you need clean air plus a mistake from him to make it work.
outcomes.attack: Passing a car with the same tyres on the same fuel is the hardest thing in the sport, and running into the back of him ends both races.

cards.reveal: Russell came in on lap 21, 3 laps after this. He finished P4, Piastri P2.

cards.title: 26 stops, and the busiest lap saw 8 of them
cards.text: Once one car stops, the cars around it have to answer.
bullets: Busiest single lap was 22, with 8 cars in under the safety car
Shortest time in the pit lane: Russell and Hamilton, 22.9s
Longest: Perez, 27.3s
cards.note: Pit lane time runs from the entry line to the exit line, stop included.

cards.title: Bearman is out
cards.text: His race ends on lap 21 of 53, in a Haas.
bullets: P18 at the start of lap 20
Started P18
3 on-track passes before it happened
cards.note: The timing feed records that he stopped, not why.

cards.title: Every gap on track, erased
cards.text: The field bunches up behind the safety car, and whatever anybody had built is gone.
bullets: Antonelli was leading when it came out
He took a stop under it, and so did Perez, Stroll, Alonso and 8 others
Neutralised until lap 27
cards.note: A lead built over a long run was worth nothing at the restart, and whoever had fresher tyres underneath him suddenly had a race again.

cards.kicker: Your call on the pit wall
cards.title: Safety car with 31 laps left. You are leading. Box or stay out?
cards.text: The pack is bunched up behind you and a stop costs far less than usual, except that everybody behind can copy you and the one who does not gets the lead.
state: Wiped out by the safety car

choices.label: Box for fresh tyres
choices.sub: Grip for the restart, hand over track position

choices.label: Stay out and defend
choices.sub: Keep the lead on older tyres

outcomes.box: New rubber under a safety car is close to free, and it only works if the cars behind stay out. If they all follow you in, you have spent your lead for nothing.
outcomes.stay: You keep the lead and restart on older tyres, with a queue of fresher cars in your mirrors and no gap to hide in.

cards.reveal: Antonelli came in. At the flag it was P1 Antonelli, P2 Piastri, P3 Leclerc.

cards.title: Yellow flags out 2 times
cards.text: Race control waves a yellow for anything on or near the track that should not be there.
bullets: A yellow means slow down and do not overtake in that part of the track

cards.title: Hulkenberg hit 308 km/h
cards.text: The fastest car in a straight line is often not the fastest car over a lap.
bullets: Hulkenberg did it in an Audi
cards.note: Top speed says as much about wing level, and about sitting in somebody's tow, as it does about the engine.

cards.title: Albon stopped 3 times
cards.text: Three stops when most of the field made 1.
bullets: In on laps 22, 45 and 49
One of them under a safety car or VSC

cards.title: Who has the fastest lap on the board at the flag?
cards.text: It usually lands late, when the car is light and the track has rubber all over it.
cards.reveal: Antonelli on lap 49, 1:32.432, in a Mercedes.

cards.title: One of these three does not see the chequered flag. Who?
cards.text: Nothing on the timing screens says it is coming.
cards.reveal: Stroll, on lap 31 of 53. The timing feed records that he stopped, not why.

cards.title: Stroll is out
cards.text: His race ends on lap 31 of 53, in an Aston Martin.
bullets: P19 at the start of lap 30
Started P22
2 on-track passes before it happened
cards.note: The timing feed records that he stopped, not why.

cards.title: Stroll was P19 a lap before his race ended on lap 31. Where does he finish if it had not?
cards.text: Nobody can answer this one for certain. You have his own lap times to go on and nothing else.

choices.label: He stays about where he was

cards.reveal: Our read from his own lap times, not a fact. He was lapping 5.07s a lap slower than Antonelli, who went on to win it. With 22 laps left, "he stays about where he was" is the honest guess, and nobody gets to check.

cards.title: Russell: 8 laps within a second of the car ahead
cards.text: The longest unbroken run like it in the race, from lap 29 to lap 36, at racing speed.
bullets: 9 other drivers had a run of five laps or more like it
cards.note: Following closely costs the car downforce and cooks the front tyres, so sitting there is harder than it looks.

cards.title: Antonelli had the quickest median racing lap
cards.text: No lap 1, no laps in or out of the pits, nothing behind the safety car or the VSC, and the slow outliers trimmed. It does not always match the result.

cards.title: 5 passes on this lap alone
cards.text: Only moves made on track count here, at racing speed.
bullets: 4 different drivers gained a place on this lap
cards.note: Every one of them on track, with no stops around it.

cards.title: Bortoleto went the other way: 4 places lost
cards.text: Qualifying promised one thing and the race delivered another.
bullets: P9 on the grid, P13 at the flag
Qualifying rewards whoever can put one lap together. A race asks for 53 of them

cards.title: Antonelli: 1:32.432
cards.text: The quickest anybody went all race, in a Mercedes.
bullets: Set on lap 49 of 53, late on, where they usually land
By then the fuel is nearly gone and the car is at its lightest
It is worth no points: the bonus point for it was dropped after 2024

cards.title: Lawson: P14 on the grid, P9 at the flag
cards.text: 5 places gained.
bullets: 1 on-track pass along the way

cards.title: Norris ran one set for 37 laps
cards.text: The longest anybody stayed out on one set.
bullets: On the hards, lap 17 to lap 53
cards.note: Every lap you stretch is a lap you do not lose in the pit lane. And every lap you stretch is a set of tyres getting slower underneath you.

cards.title: 2 incidents looked at
cards.text: Every one of them logged by race control during the race.
bullets: 2 in no further action

cards.title: Antonelli wins it
cards.text: P1 Antonelli · P2 Piastri · P3 Leclerc.
bullets: After 53 laps, Piastri crossed the line 13.722s behind

cards.title: How far behind was Piastri at the flag?
cards.text: 53 laps, 1 hour 28 minutes of racing, and it comes down to this one number.
cards.reveal: 13.722 seconds after 53 laps. A trip down the pit lane took about 24s today, which is 1.7 times the margin this race was decided by.
